android.notes: v2.3.2（两端同版本）：新增双语界面——设置里可切换语言（跟随系统 / 中文 / English），默认跟随系统，全部界面文案中英覆盖。修复：别的 APP 播放声音后手机麦克风没声——「来电暂停」原先分不清来电和媒体 APP，抢焦点会把上下行一起暂停且无法自动恢复；现已解耦，麦克风上行只有真来电才暂停，播放被抢占后会自动恢复，暂停状态在通知与主界面可见。另：采集回路加自恢复看门狗，录音器失效或被系统静音时自动重建。配对与设置原样保留，可直接覆盖升级。 / EN: New: bilingual UI — switch language in Settings (Follow system / 中文 / English, default follows system), with full Chinese/English coverage. Fixed: the phone microphone going silent after another app plays audio — the call-pause logic could not tell a call from a media app, so a focus grab paused both directions and never recovered; the directions are now decoupled (the uplink pauses only for a real phone call), playback recovers on its own, and pause states are shown in the notification and main screen. Also: a capture self-recovery watchdog rebuilds the recorder if it fails or is silenced by the system. Pairings and settings carry over; update in place as usual.

windows.notes: v2.3.2（两端同版本）：新增双语界面——设置顶部「界面语言」可切换（跟随系统 / 中文 / English），默认跟随系统；窗口、托盘、通知、更新提示与状态行全部文案中英覆盖，切换立即生效。顺带修复 v2.2 起两个本地化老问题：隐藏页面在英文界面下残留中文、部分状态文案冻结在切换前语言。本版 Windows 端无功能行为变化；手机麦克风焦点修复在安卓端（请两端同升）。注：驱动仍为测试签名版，虚拟设备仍需测试模式；虚拟摄像头仍在准备中，不在本版范围。 / EN: New: bilingual UI — a Language setting at the top of Settings (Follow system / 中文 / English, default follows system); windows, tray, notifications, update prompts and status lines are fully covered in both languages and switching applies immediately. Also fixes two localization bugs dating back to v2.2: hidden pages silently staying in Chinese under an English UI, and status texts frozen in the previously active language. No functional behaviour changes on the Windows side in this release; the microphone focus fix is on the Android side (please update both ends together). The driver is still test-signed (test mode still required); the virtual camera is still in preparation.
